sources.fact: 2020 committee considered 20/01686/FULL as detailed Phase 1 plus outline Phase 2 at Padnall Lake.
Original hybrid scheme comprised 81 detailed Phase 1 dwellings plus up to 219 outline Phase 2 dwellings, totalling 300.
Phase 1 detailed component included residential and community floorspace; phase counts are kept within the hybrid envelope.
22/01492/VAR varied conditions attached to 20/01686/FULL for Padnall Lake.
Committee minutes state the amended development would deliver 289 homes in 100% affordable housing tenures with no increase proposed.
22/01564/REM is the Phase 2 reserved-matters application pursuant to 20/01686/FULL as varied.
Phase 2 reserved matters provides 190 residential units across plots 5, 6 and 7.
The 190 Phase 2 homes are part of the amended Padnall Lake scheme and are not added on top of the 289 total.
2022 committee record states Phase 1 under construction and site clearance begun for Phase 2.

February 2024 Cabinet considered disposals across Padnall Lake Phase 2, Gascoigne East 3A Block I and Gascoigne West Phase 2 following practical completion over coming months; combined 558 figure is not assigned wholly to Padnall.
2019 Cabinet redevelopment approval for 200 affordable homes was pre-planning programme evidence and is not the final 289-home consent quantum.
Exact current application status remains case-specific and separate from title/parcel evidence.

examples.result: Original hybrid envelope 81 + 219 = 300 is historical permission structure.
